free_text: The patient is a 68-year-old male with an elevated PSA of 21.0 ng/mL and a prior biopsy showing benign findings (Gleason 0+0). MRI revealed a focal area of restricted diffusion, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was noted. The competing illness is prostate cancer. Management assessment is continued surveillance, balancing the potential benefit of intervention against the risks associated with the current findings and patient preferences.
